## d1 — terminal branch, n52–n65

Pinned HEAD verified: `ea8b12a8a9894b5259c441eadd8f6f0c65e215af`. Checkout unchanged.

**Notation:** `d` = declaration, `u` = use, `i` = implementation. Ranges are 1-based and inclusive. `+n#` inherits that node’s ranges; when expanding a union, split overlaps as needed, combining the roles of overlapping lines without counting any line twice.

**Paths:** `T`, `S`, `SS`, `P`, `Pg`, `R`, `Sel`, `VT`, and `Main` are respectively `src/terminal/{Terminal,Screen,ScreenSet,PageList,page,render,Selection,stream_terminal,main}.zig`. `H` = `src/termio/stream_handler.zig`; `IO` = `src/termio/Termio.zig`. `KG`, `KExec`, and `KStore` are `src/terminal/kitty/{graphics,graphics_exec,graphics_storage}.zig`.

- **n52** `["structure","entity","behavior","relationship","guarantee","subsystem"]` — `+n53 +n56`; `T:1–4 d, 17–41 u, 48–165 d, 227–251 d, 344–430 dui`; `Main:60–62 du`; `src/lib_vt.zig:16–21 u, 96–98 du`; `IO:40–43 du, 272–298 ui, 312–323 ui, 335–349 ui, 354–356 ui`; `src/Surface.zig:633–636 ui`; `src/renderer/State.zig:13–20 du`; `src/renderer/generic.zig:1479–1487 u`; `R:283–305 d, 941–955 ui`. Terminal implements emulator state and operations; libghostty-vt exposes it directly, while the renderer is a consumer through a separate snapshot type.
- **n53** `["behavior","relationship"]` — `+n54 +n55`; `VT:635–688 ui`; `H:208–212 d, 226–274 ui, 575–579 ui`; `T:1893–1915 di, 2207–2449 dui, 3017–3140 dui, 3235–3281 dui, 3521–3530 dui, 4133–4181 dui, 4327–4409 dui, 4441–4449 d, 4521–4543 ui`; `S:840–859 dui, 913–931 dui, 983–1135 dui, 1139–1236 dui, 1664–1668 di, 1718–1737 dui, 1861–1915 dui, 1929–2062 dui`; `Pg:2343–2348 di`; `P:4054–4088 ui, 4225–4250 ui`. Follows grid operations through actual cell writes, cursor movement, erasure and scrollback growth.
- **n54** `["structure","behavior","relationship"]` — `T:45–46 d, 55–68 d, 253–266 d, 344–376 dui, 2956–3003 dui, 3235–3256 dui, 3335–3357 dui, 4912–4921 di, 4935–4997 ui, 5049–5074 ui`; `H:307–315 u`; `S:2310–2322 ui`; `P:507–511 d`; `src/terminal/Tabstops.zig:1–10 d, 42–70 di, 77–119 di, 127–156 di, 163–175 di`.
- **n55** `["structure","relationship"]` — `T:70–87 d, 167–182 d, 268–279 d, 377–387 i, 459–478 dui, 5570–5590 dui, 5618–5638 dui`; `S:52–56 d, 143–156 d`; `src/terminal/modes.zig:15–51 di`; `src/terminal/color.zig:323–336 d, 439–443 d`; `H:358–359 u, 641 d, 675–693 ui, 1000–1011 ui, 1519–1528 ui, 1593–1602 ui, 1619–1624 d, 1637–1662 ui`. Terminal-wide cursor defaults are separate from the active screen’s cursor position and shape.
- **n56** `["structure","entity","relationship","behavior","subsystem"]` — `+n57 +n58 +n59`; `T:38 u, 48–49 d, 356–369 ui, 395–404 ui`; `SS:1–8 d, 17–36 d, 38–109 dui`; `Main:52–53 du`. ScreenSet owns the allocated screens; Terminal stores the set by value.
- **n57** `["structure","behavior","relationship","guarantee"]` — `SS:1–8 d, 17–21 d, 38–53 di, 64–67 di, 74–102 dui`; `T:344–348 d, 356–369 ui, 4912–4916 d, 4981–5047 ui, 5680–5715 dui, 5758–5762 d, 5783–5785 ui, 5868–5876 ui`; `H:707–717 u`; `VT:2034–2036 u`. Alternate is created on first need, may be freed at reset or during resize recovery, and can be created again later.
- **n58** `["structure","behavior","relationship","guarantee"]` — `SS:23–31 d, 38–53 i, 104–109 di`; `T:1893–1915 dui, 2301–2314 dui, 3235–3281 dui, 3521–3530 dui, 5680–5692 dui, 5717–5747 ui`; `R:941–947 u`.
- **n59** `["structure","entity","behavior","relationship","subsystem"]` — `+n60 +n61 +n62`; `S:1 d, 37–50 d, 315–367 dui, 983–1044 ui, 1139–1168 ui, 1718–1737 dui, 1811–1833 dui, 2310–2338 ui`; `SS:38–62 ui, 74–88 ui`; `T:522–550 ui, 5700–5702 ui, 5858–5861 u`; `R:941–955 u`. Visible rows are a viewport into Screen-owned pages, not a second screen buffer.
- **n60** `["structure"]` — `S:15–16 u, 52–65 d, 74–75 d, 143–269 d`; `Sel:24–52 d`; `src/terminal/kitty.zig:5–13 du`; `src/terminal/kitty/key.zig:5–12 d, 78–93 d`. Screen’s optional saved cursor, tracked selection, charset slots and Kitty flag stack are all per-screen.
- **n61** `["structure","behavior","relationship"]` — `S:77–141 d, 348–366 ui, 1722–1727 ui, 3001–3051 dui, 3063–3071 ui, 3095–3106 ui`; `Pg:2250–2259 d, 2437–2440 d, 2481–2492 d`; `H:364 u, 516–534 ui, 1483–1517 ui`; `T:2784–2902 dui, 3017–3050 ui, 2401–2409 ui, 4664–4671 dui`; `KG:14–32 du`; `KExec:25–37 dui, 69–76 ui, 265–270 d, 292–294 u, 362–394 ui, 1169–1175 ui`; `KStore:72–108 d, 151–172 d, 289–333 dui, 403–474 dui, 496–555 dui`; `src/Surface.zig:1712–1717 ui, 4710–4717 ui`; `R:996–1002 ui, 1289–1299 ui, 1399–1414 ui, 2114–2206 dui`. Screen invalidation flags and the Kitty image change counter are distinct.
- **n62** `["structure","entity","behavior","relationship","subsystem"]` — `+n63 +n64 +n65`; `S:15–16 u, 44–50 d, 315–347 dui, 361–367 ui, 1718–1737 ui, 1814–1833 ui, 2310–2322 ui`; `P:1–4 d, 359–392 dui, 401–405 d, 648–719 dui, 727–805 dui, 938–988 dui, 1278–1369 dui`.
- **n63** `["structure","behavior","relationship","guarantee"]` — `P:14 u, 51–63 du, 404–405 d, 465–470 d, 507–533 d, 727–805 dui, 4054–4250 dui, 6263–6286 dui, 7352–7413 dui, 7660–7722 dui`; `src/datastruct/main.zig:14 du`; `src/datastruct/intrusive_linked_list.zig:4–38 dui, 40–110 dui, 122–130 dui`. Oldest pages are at the head; the active area is the last `rows` rows and can start partway through a page.
- **n64** `["structure","entity","relationship","behavior"]` — `Pg:147–232 d, 260–323 dui, 1101–1133 dui, 1894–1943 dui, 2215–2323 d, 2392–2492 d`; `P:27–29 u, 88–108 du, 783–795 ui, 7812–7834 ui`; `T:2301–2314 ui, 2398–2409 ui`; `R:1200–1208 u, 1246–1279 u`. The backing allocation contains row headers followed by cells and metadata; a row’s offset, not its index alone, locates its cells.
- **n65** `["structure","behavior","relationship","guarantee","subsystem"]` — `P:354–357 d, 472–505 d, 518–533 d, 681–719 dui, 997–1006 di, 1060–1076 ui, 1278–1305 dui, 1320–1369 ui, 1372–1388 dui, 1502–1515 ui, 1683–1688 d, 1715–1742 ui, 1813–1848 ui, 2823 d, 2866–2873 ui, 3347–3379 dui, 3521–3558 ui, 3790–3793 d, 3844–3856 ui, 3993–4025 dui, 4061 d, 4130–4156 ui, 4725–4729 d, 4911–4926 ui, 5784–5789 d, 5863–5882 ui, 6139–6152 di, 6176–6182 ui, 6216–6253 ui, 6263–6286 dui, 6309–6334 dui, 6413–6462 dui, 7353–7362 ui, 7677–7722 dui, 7785–7818 dui`; `S:58–62 d, 195–199 d, 315–345 ui, 441–462 ui, 936–979 dui, 2234–2253 dui, 2310–2342 ui, 2368–2396 ui, 3053–3106 dui`; `Sel:24–52 d, 70–82 dui, 121–149 dui`. Covers registration and remapping of the viewport, active/saved cursors, and both selection endpoints.

**Notes:** No unresolved claim in this subset. For n65, “preserve” means following retained content and maintaining a valid pin, not retaining deleted content: destructive pruning can relocate a pin and mark it `garbage`, while the internal viewport anchor is reconciled separately.
